onyx.$description: Onyx — Primary text, icons, hairline borders, nav typography, footer text — the dominant ink across every surface

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, product card backgrounds, hero text overlays, input fills

soot.$description: Soot — Dark feature sections, inverted text on light surfaces, high-contrast blocks

ink.$description: Ink — Near-black body text variant, deep borders — virtually indistinguishable from Onyx but carries a barely-warm cast

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, muted descriptions, helper copy beneath headlines

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, captions, price labels, disabled links

ash.$description: Ash — Subtle borders, dividers between product tiles, low-emphasis separators

linen.$description: Linen — Warm taupe surface for editorial bands, soft section backgrounds — the only chromatic neutral

pistachio-wash.$description: Pistachio Wash — Promotional bar fill, seasonal event accent — the single chromatic note in the entire system, used sparingly for time-bound urgency

maison-neue-book.$description: Primary workhorse for nav, body, labels, prices, and most UI — used at 400 for body, 700 for emphasized inline text and section anchors

maison-neue-demi.$description: Rare mid-weight emphasis for sub-headers and category labels — the half-step between Book and Book Bold

maison-neue.$description: Secondary body variant for longer-form descriptive paragraphs in editorial sections

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
